title: Membership in the bad language
statement: For any data object $d$ and bit string $p$, $p$ belongs to the bad language if and only if every bit string $e$ with length at most $d.B(p.length+1)^{d.b}$ satisfies the check on the total first and second projections of $p$ and on $e$.
